items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: that Faso boy was one of the tops

ctx.x: In the old days who were the best drummers did you think? Well that boy there, that Faso boy was one of the tops. And you take Saeed, Saeed was a good man then too. He used to be a good drummer. And this boy, Burgard, B-Gard, yeah. Well that was another good drummer.
Who were the best guitar players you liked to work with?
